references.text: Describes the rule that the manslayer must remain in a city of refuge until the death of the high priest, as verse 32 forbids circumventing this by paying ransom.
Reiterates the requirement that the manslayer must stay in the city of refuge until the death of the high priest before returning to his property.
A parallel prohibition against accepting ransom for a murderer, illustrating the principle that justice cannot be bought.
The basis for the cities of refuge where someone who has killed unintentionally may flee.
Parallel legislation concerning the cities of refuge and protection for one who has killed unintentionally.
The fulfillment of the city-of-refuge system, with the rule to remain there until the death of the high priest.
